description: Check the live compliance pre-screening status, uploaded document count, compliance officer remarks, and Stage 2 secure upload URL for a submitted Hong Kong corporate bank account application (`BK-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX`). Accepts EITHER a personal API Key (`hkq_live_...`) OR `order_id` paired with the applicant's full `contact_phone`, `contact_email`, or `token` for verification.

api_key.description: Optional 86hc.com MCP API key (format: hkq_live_xxxx). Omit or leave empty to use the automatic Guest IP Trial Mode (3 free company detail queries/day + direct Stripe filing orders without a key). Free API key with 20 daily company queries available at https://www.86hc.com/user

contact_email.description: Full applicant email address used during application for ownership verification.

contact_phone.description: Full applicant contact phone number used during application for ownership verification.

order_id.description: Bank account application reference ID (e.g. BK-20261028-XXXXXX).

token.description: Optional Stage 2 resume/verification token returned upon application submission.

name: check_bank_application_status
